## Codex execution contract

**CGS-20 authorization and evidence contract:** Resolve the selected project root, stage, target devices and certification tier from actual configuration; unset is unknown, not `none`. Local review and dry-run results do not authorize any external write. Real storefront uploads, steamcmd, butler, deploys, publishing, Git push, tags, merges or release creation require applicable user authorization, including any still-valid explicit authorization already granted. A review or dry-run request does not authorize an official release; honor the user's applicable explicit scope. Do not start unrequested follow-ups; honor explicitly authorized chains. Verify required artifacts, review/QA results and platform-specific rollback evidence; missing or unrun inputs remain NOT ASSESSED or blocking as appropriate. In-session role review is not independent sign-off.

Explicit invocation only. Check stage and an actual release-gate PASS before relying on reduced QA; a missing gate is NOT ASSESSED and a failing/unassessed gate cannot become an approved release. Define a platform-appropriate rollback plan before any fix; an interruption retains open status and no deployment. Required QA and real sign-offs cannot be replaced by in-session assumptions.
